title: A Mysterious Nonprofit Run by SpaceXAI’s Top Lawyer Is Paying the Salaries of Government Workers
gist: A WIRED investigation finds at least two National Design Studio staff on loan to the Office of Personnel Management are employed by the America by Design Foundation, a nonprofit apparently run by SpaceXAI general counsel James Burnham. Funding for the foundation is unknown, and experts say the arrangement mirrors DOGE's tactics for bringing chosen staff into government.

insights.claim: The National Design Studio, led by Airbnb cofounder Joe Gebbia and housed in the Executive Office of the President, was announced in August 2025 and has redesigned government sites such as TrumpRx and RealFood.gov.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: A DOGE-descended unit now sets the design of federal digital services.

insights.claim: Several DOGE alumni moved into NDS after Musk left DOGE in late spring 2025, including Edward Coristine as head of engineering, plus Akash Bobba and Zachary Terrell.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: Personnel continuity suggests DOGE's model persists under a new name.

insights.claim: NDS recently launched America.gov, an AI-driven site meant to consolidate services such as tax filing and passport renewal into one portal, and earlier NDS sites reportedly installed visitor-tracking software that appeared to violate the 1974 Privacy Act until The Guardian reported it.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: AI-driven consolidation of citizen services carries privacy-compliance risk.

insights.claim: Documents reviewed by WIRED show NDS members Amittai Groot and John Cafazza are employed by the America by Design Foundation and detailed to OPM under the Intergovernment Personnel Act, with Cafazza's term running May 2026 to May 2028.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: Government work is being staffed by employees of an opaque private entity.

insights.claim: OPM will reimburse the foundation $13,691 a month for Groot, only part of his salary, which exceeds the government pay scale so the foundation covers the rest, while the foundation appears to cover Cafazza's full cost.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: An unidentified funder is effectively subsidizing federal staff salaries.

insights.claim: NDS appears to use the Intergovernment Personnel Act, which lets people from universities and nonprofits work in government for up to two years, as a substitute for the special-government-employee route DOGE used (120 days a year, reduced disclosure).
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: Alternate hiring channels let political appointees bypass the full federal hiring process.

insights.claim: Erie Meyer says IPAs require at least 90 days at the home organization before being loaned, which does not seem satisfied for Groot, who entered government less than a month after being hired by the foundation.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: Possible rule violations add to legal exposure for the arrangement.

insights.claim: Meyer argues IPAs are not meant to be core to an agency or to displace federal employees, and that using the system to evade hiring protections is improper.
insights.speaker: Erie Meyer
insights.so_what: Experts see the use of IPAs here as outside the intended purpose.
insights.quote: You can't just use the IPA system to evade hiring protections.
insights.locator: I used to bring in AI experts in 2021

insights.claim: The America by Design Foundation was registered August 25, 2025, four days after NDS was officially established, received tax exemption on September 22, 2025, and has no tax filings available or known funders.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: The foundation's timing implies it was created in tandem with NDS.

insights.claim: James Burnham, SpaceXAI's top lawyer and former DOGE general counsel, is listed as the foundation's managing director, and its registered address in the System for Award Management appears to be his home in Alexandria, Virginia.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: A direct personal link ties the foundation to a company with large federal exposure.

insights.claim: SpaceXAI has received billions of dollars in federal contracts, works with the government to integrate Grok, has substantial regulatory business before it, and is run by the GOP's top funder.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: Conflict-of-interest risk if the foundation's funding traces to affiliated interests.

insights.claim: The foundation filed a Department of Labor H-1B application for a 'member of technical staff' running April 2026 to April 2029, with a salary range of $175,427 to $340,000, near or above the federal pay scale top of $197,200.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: Foreign-national staffing in the DOGE/NDS orbit is a recurring oversight question.

insights.claim: An H-1B search for the foundation returns Jennifer Michelsen, cofounder of Gunnar, whose husband Matt Michelsen founded Gothams LLC, which won a $33 million contract for the 'Alligator Alcatraz' detention facility.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: Connections to contractors with federal business widen the web of potential interests.

insights.claim: Don Moynihan says it is troubling not to know who employs and pays these people, especially given movement between private and public sectors.
insights.speaker: Don Moynihan
insights.so_what: Transparency over who pays government workers is the core accountability gap.
insights.quote: We should know who is paying the salaries of government employees.
insights.locator: It makes you ask, What does this outside organization get out of this?

insights.claim: The White House did not answer questions and referred WIRED to OPM, which also did not respond.
insights.speaker: Vittoria Elliott
insights.so_what: No official explanation of the arrangement exists.
